modelValue.zh-CN: 当前选中的节点的 value（没有 value 时为 key），用 v-model 绑定；多选时只接受数组。传入后即为受控组件，传入 undefined 会清空选中项。
modelValue.en-US: Value of the selected node (its key when it has no value), bound with v-model; an array only when multiple. Passing it makes the component controlled, and undefined clears the selection.

defaultValue.zh-CN: 指定默认选中的条目，只在挂载时读取；多选时只接受数组。
defaultValue.en-US: The initially selected items, read once on mount; an array only when multiple.

multiple.zh-CN: 是否多选。多选时所有子项都被选择会自动勾选其父项。
multiple.en-US: Whether several nodes can be selected. A parent is checked automatically once all its children are.

treeData.zh-CN: 节点数据，key 在整棵树内唯一。只有传入新数组才会更新，原地修改数组或节点不会生效。
treeData.en-US: Node data; keys are unique across the tree. Only a new array updates the options, changes made in place are not seen.

keyMaps.zh-CN: 自定义节点中 key、label、value、disabled、children、isLeaf、icon 的字段名。映射了 label 且开启搜索时，需把 treeNodeFilterProp 设为 treeData 的键之一，或自定义 filterTreeNode。
keyMaps.en-US: Custom field names for key, label, value, disabled, children, isLeaf and icon in a node. When label is mapped and search is on, set treeNodeFilterProp to one of the keys in treeData or provide filterTreeNode.

treeNodeLabelProp.zh-CN: 作为选择框中显示文字的节点属性，默认 label。
treeNodeLabelProp.en-US: The node field shown in the trigger, label by default.

treeNodeFilterProp.zh-CN: 搜索时用于匹配输入的节点属性，默认 label。
treeNodeFilterProp.en-US: The node field matched against the search input, label by default.

filterTreeNode.zh-CN: 是否根据输入项筛选：true 时按 treeNodeFilterProp 对应的属性值匹配，也可以传入自定义的匹配函数。
filterTreeNode.en-US: Whether to filter by the input: true matches the field named by treeNodeFilterProp, or pass a custom matching function.

showFilteredOnly.zh-CN: 搜索时只展示过滤后的结果。
showFilteredOnly.en-US: Shows only the filtered nodes while searching.

searchPosition.zh-CN: 搜索框的位置：dropdown 在下拉面板中，trigger 在选择框内。
searchPosition.en-US: Where the search box sits: dropdown in the panel, trigger inside the select box.

searchPlaceholder.zh-CN: 下拉面板中搜索框的占位文字。
searchPlaceholder.en-US: Placeholder of the search box in the dropdown.

showSearchClear.zh-CN: 搜索框是否显示清除按钮。
showSearchClear.en-US: Whether the search box shows a clear button.

remote.zh-CN: 是否启用远程搜索：输入时跳过本地过滤，只触发 search 事件，由使用方获取数据并更新 treeData。
remote.en-US: Enables remote search: typing skips local filtering and only emits search, so the caller can fetch data and update treeData.

expandAll.zh-CN: 展开所有节点，treeData 变化后仍然生效。
expandAll.en-US: Expands every node, and keeps doing so when treeData changes.

defaultExpandAll.zh-CN: 初始化时展开所有节点。之后 treeData 的变化不再影响展开状态，需要时使用 expandAll。
defaultExpandAll.en-US: Expands every node on mount. Later changes of treeData do not affect it; use expandAll for that.

defaultExpandedKeys.zh-CN: 默认展开的节点，显示其直接子级。
defaultExpandedKeys.en-US: Nodes expanded initially, showing their direct children.

expandedKeys.zh-CN: 展开的节点，用 v-model:expandedKeys 绑定。传入后展开状态完全受控。
expandedKeys.en-US: Expanded nodes, bound with v-model:expandedKeys. Passing it makes expansion fully controlled.

autoExpandParent.zh-CN: expandedKeys 变化时是否自动展开其中节点的父节点；挂载时总会展开。开启后，展开受控时要先收起所有已展开的子节点才能收起父节点。
autoExpandParent.en-US: Whether the parents of the nodes in expandedKeys expand automatically when expandedKeys changes; they always do on mount. When on, controlled expansion collapses a parent only after its expanded children are collapsed.

expandAction.zh-CN: 展开逻辑：false 仅点击展开箭头时展开，click 单击节点展开，doubleClick 双击节点展开。键盘不触发该逻辑。
expandAction.en-US: How a node expands: false only through the arrow, click on a click, doubleClick on a double click. The keyboard does not use it.

motionExpand.zh-CN: 是否开启节点展开收起的动画；虚拟化时动画关闭。
motionExpand.en-US: Whether expanding and collapsing nodes are animated; animation is off for a virtualized list.

loadData.zh-CN: 异步加载节点的子级，返回 Promise；未设置 isLeaf 的节点在它存在时显示展开箭头。返回的 Promise 被拒绝后节点可以再次展开重试。
loadData.en-US: Loads the children of a node and returns a Promise; a node without isLeaf shows the expand arrow while it is set. After a rejection the node can be expanded again to retry.

loadedKeys.zh-CN: 已加载的节点，配合 loadData 使用，用 v-model:loadedKeys 绑定。
loadedKeys.en-US: Nodes already loaded, used with loadData and bound with v-model:loadedKeys.

leafOnly.zh-CN: 多选时，值、change 事件的载荷和展示的标签只包含叶子节点。
leafOnly.en-US: In multiple mode, the value, the payload of change and the displayed tags hold leaf nodes only.

checkRelation.zh-CN: 多选时节点之间选中状态的关系：related 为父子联动，unRelated 为互不影响。
checkRelation.en-US: How the checked states of nodes relate in multiple mode: related links parents and children, unRelated keeps them independent.

disableStrictly.zh-CN: 严格禁用：禁用的节点不能通过父级或子级的选中关系改变状态。
disableStrictly.en-US: Strict disabling: a disabled node cannot change state through the selection of its parent or children.

autoMergeValue.zh-CN: 父节点被选中时，值不再包含它的子孙节点；leafOnly 为 false 时生效。
autoMergeValue.en-US: When a parent is selected the value leaves out its descendants; applies when leafOnly is false.

changeWithObject.zh-CN: 布尔属性而不是事件：设为 true 时，modelValue 与 change 的载荷由 value 变为节点对象；受控时 modelValue 与 defaultValue 也要传对象，且必须含 value。
changeWithObject.en-US: A boolean attribute, not an event: when true the payload of modelValue and change is the node object instead of its value; a controlled modelValue and defaultValue must then be objects with a value.

maxTagCount.zh-CN: 多选时最多显示的标签数量，超出部分以 +N 展示。
maxTagCount.en-US: The most tags shown in multiple mode; the rest collapse into +N.

showRestTagsPopover.zh-CN: 超出 maxTagCount 后，hover +N 时是否用 Popover 显示剩余标签。
showRestTagsPopover.en-US: Whether hovering +N shows the remaining tags in a Popover once maxTagCount is exceeded.

restTagsPopoverProps.zh-CN: 剩余标签 Popover 的配置，参考 Popover。
restTagsPopoverProps.en-US: Configuration of the Popover for the remaining tags; see Popover.

labelEllipsis.zh-CN: label 超出时是否省略；虚拟化时默认开启。
labelEllipsis.en-US: Whether an overflowing label is truncated; on by default for a virtualized list.

showLine.zh-CN: 下拉面板中显示节点之间的连接线。
showLine.en-US: Shows connecting lines between nodes in the dropdown.

virtualize.zh-CN: 列表虚拟化，用于大量节点：height、width、itemSize（必传）。开启后动画关闭。
virtualize.en-US: List virtualization for many nodes: height, width and itemSize (required). Animation is off once enabled.

size.en-US: Size of the select box: small, default or large.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，只影响样式：default、warning 或 error。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status, which only affects the style: default, warning or error.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: insetLabel 插槽外层元素的 id，供 aria-labelledby 引用；不传时使用内部生成的 id。
insetLabelId.en-US: The id of the element around the insetLabel slot, for aria-labelledby to point at; an internal id is used when omitted.

showClear.zh-CN: 有值时选择框是否显示清除按钮。
showClear.en-US: Whether the select box shows a clear button when it has a value.

clickToHide.zh-CN: 单选时选中节点后是否关闭下拉面板。
clickToHide.en-US: Whether the dropdown closes after a node is selected in single mode.

clickTriggerToHide.zh-CN: 下拉面板打开时，点击选择框是否关闭面板。
clickTriggerToHide.en-US: Whether clicking the select box closes the open dropdown.

motion.zh-CN: 下拉面板是否有出现和消失的动画。
motion.en-US: Whether the dropdown animates in and out.

autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 下拉面板被遮挡时是否自动调整方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether the dropdown flips when it would be clipped.

position.zh-CN: 下拉面板的位置，可选值参考 Tooltip 的 position。
position.en-US: Position of the dropdown; see the position of Tooltip.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止下拉面板上的点击事件冒泡；传入字符串时按布尔值处理。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether click events on the dropdown stop propagating; a string is treated as a boolean.

dropdownMatchSelectWidth.zh-CN: 下拉面板的最小宽度是否等于选择框的宽度。
dropdownMatchSelectWidth.en-US: Whether the minimum width of the dropdown equals the width of the select box.

optionListStyle.zh-CN: 节点列表（role="tree" 的元素）的样式。
optionListStyle.en-US: Style of the node list, the element with role="tree".

preventScroll.zh-CN: 聚焦时是否阻止浏览器滚动页面以显示新聚焦的元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focusing stops the browser from scrolling the page to the newly focused element.

triggerTagWrap.zh-CN: 是否允许触发器内的多选标签换行；仅在 multiple、filterTreeNode 开启且 searchPosition 为 trigger 时生效。
triggerTagWrap.en-US: Lets the tags in the trigger wrap onto more lines; applies with multiple, filterTreeNode and searchPosition set to trigger.

update:modelValue.zh-CN: 选中值变化时触发，v-model 使用；清空时载荷为 undefined。
update:modelValue.en-US: Emitted when the selection changes; used by v-model. The payload is undefined once cleared.

change.zh-CN: 选中值变化时触发，载荷依次为值、节点和触发事件，值与 update:modelValue 相同。清空和多选时分别为 undefined 与数组；通过关闭标签触发时事件为 null；开启 changeWithObject 后值与节点是同一个节点对象。会遮住根元素上同名的原生事件。
change.en-US: Emitted when the selection changes, with the value, the node and the triggering event; the value equals that of update:modelValue. It is undefined once cleared and arrays in multiple mode; the event is null for a closed tag; with changeWithObject the value and the node are the same node object. It shadows the native event of the same name on the root element.

update:expandedKeys.zh-CN: 展开的节点变化时触发，v-model:expandedKeys 使用。
update:expandedKeys.en-US: Emitted when the expanded nodes change; used by v-model:expandedKeys.

expand.zh-CN: 展开或收起节点时触发，info 含 expanded 与 node。
expand.en-US: Emitted when a node expands or collapses; info holds expanded and node.

update:loadedKeys.zh-CN: 已加载的节点变化时触发，v-model:loadedKeys 使用。
update:loadedKeys.en-US: Emitted when the loaded nodes change; used by v-model:loadedKeys.

load.zh-CN: 节点加载完毕时触发，loadedKeys 为已加载节点 key 的 Set。
load.en-US: Emitted when a node has loaded; loadedKeys is the Set of keys of loaded nodes.

select.zh-CN: 节点被选中或取消选中时触发，载荷为该节点的 key、是否选中和节点数据。会遮住根元素上同名的原生事件。
select.en-US: Emitted when a node is selected or deselected, with its key, whether it is selected and its data. It shadows the native event of the same name on the root element.

search.zh-CN: 搜索框的值变化时触发；filteredExpandedKeys 是因搜索或 modelValue、defaultValue 而展开的节点，可在展开受控时用来展开搜索结果；filteredNodes 是搜索命中的节点。
search.en-US: Emitted when the search input changes; filteredExpandedKeys are the nodes expanded by the search or by modelValue and defaultValue, which controlled expansion can use to show the results; filteredNodes are the nodes that matched.

dropdownVisibleChange.zh-CN: 下拉面板显示或隐藏时触发。组件在 KeepAlive 中停用时会关闭面板并发出 false，不发出 blur。
dropdownVisibleChange.en-US: Emitted when the dropdown opens or closes. Deactivating the component inside KeepAlive closes it and emits false, without a blur.

focus.zh-CN: 焦点从外部进入选择框（含其中的搜索框、清除按钮）或下拉面板时触发，载荷是 FocusEvent；焦点在它们之间移动不重复触发。选中节点并关闭面板后再次点击或按键打开时也会触发，载荷为该次点击或按键的事件；searchAutoFocus 挂载时自动聚焦的载荷为 null。禁用时不触发。会遮住根元素上同名的原生事件。
focus.en-US: Emitted when focus enters the select box (including its search box and clear button) or the dropdown from outside, with a FocusEvent; moving between them does not emit again. It also fires when a click or key reopens the dropdown after a selection closed it, with that click or key event, and null for searchAutoFocus on mount. It is not emitted while disabled. It shadows the native event of the same name on the root element.

blur.zh-CN: 每次 focus 之后只触发一次：焦点离开选择框和下拉面板时载荷是 FocusEvent，点击外部时是 MouseEvent，选中节点并关闭面板时是该次点击或按键的事件。会遮住根元素上同名的原生事件。
blur.en-US: Emitted once after each focus: a FocusEvent when focus leaves the select box and the dropdown, a MouseEvent for a click outside, and the click or key event when a selection closes the dropdown. It shadows the native event of the same name on the root element.

clear.zh-CN: 点击或用键盘触发清除按钮时触发，载荷是触发清除的事件，通过插槽函数清除且没有事件时为 null。
clear.en-US: Emitted when the clear button is used by click or keyboard; the payload is the triggering event, null when cleared through a slot function without an event.

keydown.zh-CN: 按键事件，先于 TreeSelect 自身的按键处理触发。会遮住根元素上同名的原生事件。
keydown.en-US: A key press, emitted before the TreeSelect handles the key. It shadows the native event of the same name on the root element.

label.zh-CN: 自定义节点的 label 内容。开启搜索时仍按 treeData 中的 label 文本匹配。
label.en-US: Content of a node's label. Search still matches the label text in treeData.

icon.zh-CN: 自定义节点图标，按节点数据返回不同内容。
icon.en-US: A node's icon, which can differ by node data.

expandIcon.zh-CN: 自定义展开图标。返回单个元素时自动获得 class 与展开的点击处理；也可以用参数自行绑定。
expandIcon.en-US: The expand icon. A single element gets the class and the click that expands; the parameters can also be bound by hand.

fullLabel.zh-CN: 接管整行的内容。带 id、role 与状态的行元素由 TreeSelect 提供，插槽只写行内内容。
fullLabel.en-US: Content of the whole row. TreeSelect provides the row element carrying the id, role and state; the slot holds only what is inside.

selectedItem.zh-CN: 自定义已选项：单选时是选择框中显示的内容，多选时是内置标签里的内容；内容为空时单选显示占位文字，多选不渲染该标签。
selectedItem.en-US: A selected item: the content shown in the select box in single mode, or the content of a built-in tag in multiple mode; empty content shows the placeholder in single mode and leaves the tag out in multiple mode.

tag.zh-CN: 多选时替换每个标签，优先于 selectedItem；内容为空时不渲染该标签。
tag.en-US: Replaces each tag in multiple mode, taking precedence over selectedItem; empty content leaves the tag out.

trigger.zh-CN: 替换整个触发器的内容，参数含已选节点、输入值以及 onSearch、onClear、onRemove 方法。
trigger.en-US: Replaces the content of the trigger; the parameters hold the selected nodes, the input value, and the onSearch, onClear and onRemove methods.

search.zh-CN: 替换搜索框，参数可以直接 v-bind 到 Semi 的 Input 上，其中 inputRef 必须绑定；插槽内容为空时隐藏搜索框。
search.en-US: Replaces the search box. The parameters can be bound to a Semi Input with v-bind, and inputRef must be bound; an empty slot hides the search box.

prefix.en-US: Content before the value in the select box.

suffix.en-US: Content after the value in the select box.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 选择框内的内嵌标签，同时作为下拉树的名称来源。
insetLabel.en-US: A label inside the select box, which also names the dropdown tree.

arrowIcon.zh-CN: 自定义右侧下拉箭头；插槽内容为空时隐藏箭头。showClear 开启且有值时，hover 优先显示清除按钮。
arrowIcon.en-US: The dropdown arrow on the right; an empty slot hides it. With showClear and a value, hovering shows the clear button first.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除按钮的图标，showClear 为 true 时有效；内容为空时使用默认图标。
clearIcon.en-US: The icon of the clear button, used when showClear is true; empty content keeps the default icon.

emptyContent.zh-CN: 没有节点或搜索无结果时的内容；插槽内容为空时隐藏空状态。
emptyContent.en-US: Content shown when there are no nodes or the search finds none; an empty slot hides the empty state.

outerTopSlot.zh-CN: 渲染在下拉面板顶部、与节点列表平级的内容；它取代下拉面板中的搜索框。
outerTopSlot.en-US: Content at the top of the dropdown, beside the node list; it takes the place of the search box in the dropdown.

outerBottomSlot.zh-CN: 渲染在下拉面板底部、与节点列表平级的内容。
outerBottomSlot.en-US: Content at the bottom of the dropdown, beside the node list.
